findings.issue: Payment verification accepts any signature. RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET declared but never used for HMAC. /api/orders/verify blindly marks orders as PAID.
findings.impact: Complete payment bypass. Anyone can unlock all content for free.
findings.fix: Implement Razorpay HMAC signature verification using crypto.createHmac.

findings.issue: Hardcoded JWT secret fallback: 'the_law_kaksha_secure_jwt_secret_key_2026'
findings.impact: Anyone with source access can forge JWT tokens for any user including admin.
findings.fix: Remove hardcoded fallback. Crash on startup if JWT_SECRET is not set.

findings.issue: Hardcoded Razorpay secret: 'lawkaksha_rzp_secret_2026'
findings.impact: Razorpay API secret exposed. Could be used to manipulate merchant account.
findings.fix: Remove hardcoded default. Require env var at boot.

findings.issue: CORS callback returns true for ALL origins unconditionally.
findings.impact: Any malicious website can make authenticated cross-origin requests.
findings.fix: Remove catch-all line 46. Return error for disallowed origins.

findings.issue: No Razorpay SDK integrated. Order IDs generated locally. Frontend sends mock payment IDs.
findings.impact: Zero real payments are processed. E-commerce model is non-functional.
findings.fix: Integrate razorpay npm SDK for server-side order creation and checkout.js on frontend.

findings.issue: Admin and student credentials displayed in login page UI.
findings.impact: Any visitor can log in as admin and access all admin functionality.
findings.fix: Remove demo credentials from production build.

findings.issue: /api/students and /api/students/profile have no authentication. Return all student PII.
findings.impact: Anyone can enumerate all student personal data. DPDP Act violation.
findings.fix: Add requireAdmin middleware to both endpoints.

findings.issue: No rate limiting on login or register endpoints.
findings.impact: Unlimited brute-force attempts. Unlimited spam registrations.
findings.fix: Install express-rate-limit. Apply 5/min on login, 3/min on register.

findings.issue: No helmet middleware. No CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options headers.
findings.impact: XSS, clickjacking, MIME sniffing not mitigated.
findings.fix: npm install helmet && app.use(helmet())

findings.issue: Profile update accepts input without validation or sanitization.
findings.impact: Stored XSS possible. Oversized payloads can bloat JSON DB.
findings.fix: Add express-validator or zod for all request bodies.

findings.issue: Order verify reassigns order to logged-in user if IDs differ. Any user can claim any order.
findings.impact: Entitlement theft. Any authenticated user can steal another's purchases.
findings.fix: Remove user-rebinding logic. Orders verifiable only by owner or webhook.

findings.issue: JWT tokens expire in 30 days. No revocation mechanism.
findings.impact: Compromised tokens valid for a month. Cannot force-logout users.
findings.fix: 1-hour access tokens + refresh tokens. Token blacklist.

findings.issue: No password complexity requirements. Only checks if password exists.
findings.impact: Users can register with trivially weak passwords.
findings.fix: Enforce minimum 8 characters, complexity rules or zxcvbn scoring.

findings.issue: Registration reveals if email already has an account.
findings.impact: User enumeration for targeted attacks.
findings.fix: Generic message for all registration attempts.

findings.issue: JWT token and user object stored in localStorage.
findings.impact: Token theft if XSS exists. localStorage accessible to any JS on origin.
findings.fix: Use httpOnly cookies for token transport.

findings.issue: Database is in-memory JS object flushed to JSON file. No ACID, no concurrency, no constraints.
findings.impact: Data loss on crash. Race conditions. Unscalable. Render free tier ephemeral disk.
findings.fix: Replace with PostgreSQL, Supabase, or at minimum SQLite with WAL.

findings.issue: No backup mechanism, no PITR, no replication.
findings.impact: Any corruption or deletion loses ALL data.
findings.fix: Automated daily backups. Use real database with PITR.

findings.issue: update() has no locking. Concurrent requests cause lost updates.
findings.impact: Enrollment, order, and profile updates silently lost under concurrent load.
findings.fix: Use database with row-level locking.

findings.issue: seed() is async but called without await. Server accepts requests before DB is ready.
findings.impact: Race condition on cold start — requests may see empty database.
findings.fix: await seed() before app.listen(). Gate readiness on seed completion.

findings.issue: Multiple components exceed 500 LOC. Admin page is 1900 lines in a single file.
findings.impact: Unmaintainable code. Extremely difficult to review, test, or modify.
findings.fix: Break into sub-components per section.

findings.issue: Product detail page is 0 bytes — empty file.
findings.impact: Broken navigation. Users clicking product links see nothing.
findings.fix: Implement product detail page or remove the route.

findings.issue: All queries are O(n) Array.filter scans. Admin endpoints are O(n*m*p).
findings.impact: Admin dashboard timeouts at scale. Server OOM at 100K orders.
findings.fix: Real database with indexes. Add pagination with limit/offset.

findings.issue: Array.unshift() on every insert is O(n) due to array reindexing.
findings.impact: Write performance degrades linearly with dataset size.
findings.fix: Use Array.push() or a real database.

findings.issue: Backend on Render free tier. Cold starts after 15min idle. Ephemeral disk.
findings.impact: 30-60s first-request latency. Potential data loss on disk reset.
findings.fix: Upgrade to paid tier or use hosted database.

findings.issue: No graceful shutdown handler. No SIGTERM handling. No request draining.
findings.impact: In-flight requests killed on deploy. Potential data corruption.
findings.fix: Add SIGTERM handler with connection drain and final save.

findings.issue: No structured logging. console.log only. No correlation IDs.
findings.impact: Cannot trace, filter, or aggregate logs. No incident visibility.
findings.fix: Use pino or winston with JSON output and request IDs.

findings.issue: Only 1 test file with 12 assertions. No unit tests. No frontend tests. No framework. No CI.
findings.impact: Cannot verify correctness. Regressions ship undetected.
findings.fix: Add Jest/Vitest + Playwright. CI gating.

findings.issue: E2E test validates the payment bypass works (passes fake signatures).
findings.impact: False confidence in security. Test certifies broken behavior.
findings.fix: Fix SEC-001 first, then test that invalid signatures are rejected.

findings.issue: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions. No build/test gates.
findings.impact: Every push goes directly to production without quality checks.
findings.fix: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml with lint, typecheck, test, build.

findings.issue: No Docker configuration. Cannot reproduce production environment locally.
findings.impact: Environment parity issues. 'Works on my machine' problems.
findings.fix: Add Dockerfile (multi-stage, non-root) and docker-compose.yml.

findings.issue: Student PII exposed without authentication. No consent mechanism. No data deletion.
findings.impact: India DPDP Act 2023 violation. All student PII publicly accessible.
findings.fix: Auth on PII endpoints. Privacy policy. Consent capture. Data deletion API.

findings.issue: JSON-LD claims 4.9 rating from 3840 reviews. Actual DB has 4 reviews.
findings.impact: Misleading structured data. Google policy violation. Consumer protection risk.
findings.fix: Generate aggregate rating from actual review data.

findings.issue: Cart pre-populated with item and coupon on first visit. Dark pattern.
findings.impact: User trust erosion. Inflated conversion metrics.
findings.fix: Start with empty cart.

findings.issue: Device DRM is entirely client-side with hardcoded fake data.
findings.impact: False sense of security. Bypassed by clearing localStorage.
findings.fix: Implement real server-side device binding or remove the UI.

findings.issue: Forgot Password link is non-functional span with no action.
findings.impact: Users who forget passwords are permanently locked out.
findings.fix: Implement password reset flow with email token.
